! Game text
| Deploy on Death Star: Trench. During your move phase, you may make an Attack Run as follows: Enter Trench: Move up to 3 of your starfighters into trench (for free). Dark Side may immediately follow with up to 3 TIEs (for free). Provide Cover: Identify your lead starfighter (Proton Torpedoes* required) and wingmen (if any). Turbolaser Batteries and TIEs with weapons may now target your starfighters (wingmen first, then lead if no wingmen remaining). Hit starfighters are immediately lost. It's Away!: Draw two destiny. Pull Up!: All starfighters now move to Death Star system (for free). If (total destiny + X + Y - Z) &gt; 15, Death Star is "blown away." X = ability of lead pilot or 3 if Targeting Computer is present. Y = total sites at largest Rebel Base (Yavin 4 or Hoth). Z = highest ability of TIE pilots present. *Immune to Overload during Attack Run. || Deploy on Death Star: Trench. During your move phase, you may make an Attack Run as follows: Enter Trench: Move up to 3 of your starfighters into trench (for free). Dark Side may immediately follow with up to 3 TIEs (for free). Provide Cover: Identify your lead starfighter (Proton Torpedoes* required) and wingmen (if any). Turbolaser Batteries and TIEs with weapons may now target your starfighters (wingmen first, then lead if no wingmen remaining). Hit starfighters are immediately lost. It's Away!: Draw two destiny. Pull Up!: All starfighters now move to Death Star system (for free). If (total destiny + X + Y - Z) &gt; 15, Death Star is "blown away." X = ability of lead pilot or 3 if Targeting Computer is present. Y = total sites at largest Rebel Base (Yavin 4 or Hoth). Z = highest ability of TIE pilots present. {{Errata hl|1=* Your Proton Torpedoes are immune to Overload}}. || Deploy on Death Star: Trench. During your move phase, you may make an Attack Run as follows: Enter Trench: Move up to 3 of your starfighters into trench (for free). Dark Side may immediately follow with up to 3 TIEs (for free). Provide Cover: Identify your lead starfighter (Proton Torpedoes * required) and wingmen (if any). Turbolaser Batteries and TIEs with weapons may now target your starfighters (wingmen first, then lead if no wingmen remaining). Hit starfighters are immediately lost. It's Away!: Draw two destiny. Pull Up!: All starfighters now move to Death Star system (for free). If (total destiny + X + Y - Z) &gt; 15, Death Star is "blown away." X = ability of lead pilot {{Errata hl|1=(or 3 if Targeting Computer aboard) just before Pull Up!}} Y = total sites at largest Rebel Base (Yavin 4 or Hoth). Z = highest ability of {{Errata hl|1=opponent's}} TIE pilots in trench {{Errata hl|1=just before Pull Up!}} *Your Proton Torpedoes are immune to Overload.

== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original [[Attack Run]], [[Attack Run (Errata)]], and [[Attack Run (PC Errata)]] articles. Columns are Original · Decipher Errata (Glossary Supplement last line) · PC Errata (Appendix A). Print uid <code>2_42o</code>, Decipher <code>2_42d</code>, PC bare <code>2_42</code>. The later D-E1 Holotable PNG is the same Appendix A wording as the earlier E-marked face and is not a PC Errata 2 column. Do not transclude onto Revised, Japanese, Reflections foil, or (V). {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words that changed from the previous filled column. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
